storage_preflight.policy: header-derived complete payload, largest one-tensor serialization, two CoW headers and conservative allocation slack; originals never deleted

conversion.source_policy: first original generation SHA then durable metadata reuse; original sources read-only
conversion.scope: same g32 compressed planes for native and configured mflux; stock defaultg64 is separately measured; original embeddings/VAE unchanged; DiT and encoder eligible linears quantized

timing_scope: complete PNG request wall; constructor separate; cold/two fresh/repeat, no added phase fences
source_policy: first source-generation SHA then durable registration reuse; stat guards between arms, no per-inference model SHA or OS cache purge
representation_scope: same base checkpoint; BF16 source versus matched full-linear Q4/g32; partial FP16, BF16 predecode rounding and INT8-weight/FP16-I/O hybrid explicitly separate arithmetic

report.instrumentation: native branch-event observer; no added GPU fences
